preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 5 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range 1 to n.
The number of test cases t is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and 1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and uj != vj and xj != yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains four distinct cities within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == 0 or result > 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either 0 or a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or result % 2 == 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or an even integer.
